goal:
Implement openspec/changes/add-deploy-build-sizing (ACTIVE BUILD). Contract: its proposal.md, tasks.md, steer.md and specs/deploy-build/spec.md. Read those first. add-deploy-step-inputs already landed (119c798) in the same modules; build on it, do not rework it.

Today the build VM gets :deploy_build_memory_mb (lib/mjolnir/deploy/orchestrator.ex:403 build_memory_mb, default 2048 at :56) and the host :default_vcpus (config/config.exs:19, consumed at lib/mjolnir/vm.ex:2022), the same for every app. build_opts (orchestrator.ex, the spawn_opts map with extra_mounts) never passes vcpus.

Land:
- lib/mjolnir/deploy/manifest.ex: optional `build = { vcpus, memory_mb }` table (positive integers; any other key refused before boot, naming it). Expose it on the parsed plan. Document it in the module doc's Fields table.
- config/config.exs: host defaults deploy_build_vcpus: 4, deploy_build_memory_mb: 4096, deploy_build_max_vcpus and deploy_build_max_memory_mb (pick ceilings that fit an 8-core / 31 GB host, e.g. 6 and 16384). Do not change :default_vcpus (service VMs).
- lib/mjolnir/deploy/orchestrator.ex: build VM size = manifest build.* else host default, clamped to the max; pass both vcpus and memory_mb in build spawn_opts. Service VM sizing (run_opts / :memory_mb) untouched. Emit a progress line before building: `build VM: <v> vCPU, <m> MB`, plus `<key> <requested> -> <clamped> (host max)` when clamped.
- lib/mjolnir/deploy/diagnostics.ex: when a build step fails with {:vsock_unavailable, ...}, the message states the build VM's memory and names build.memory_mb to raise. Keep the existing diagnostics behavior otherwise.
- Tests in the listed files: manifest value wins over host default; ceiling clamps and is reported; service VM memory unaffected; vcpus reaches spawn_opts; malformed build table refused; diagnostic text on agent loss.

Mix may fail in your sandbox (TCP filesystem lock :eperm, seen on the previous node); if so, report it as a blocker and stop rather than working around the lock. The conductor runs `mix test test/mjolnir/deploy`. Check matching boxes in openspec/changes/add-deploy-build-sizing/tasks.md only for tests you actually ran green. Edit and stop. Do not fold. Do not push.
